scenario: Phishing seen through D3FEND 1.6.0: the ATT&CK techniques Spearphishing Attachment and Link and the User Execution that follows, the email, URL, mail traffic and executable file artifacts they produce, access or execute, and the D3FEND defensive techniques that analyse, filter or block those artifacts, such as Sender Reputation Analysis, Homoglyph Detection, URL Analysis, Email Filtering, Dynamic Analysis and Executable Allowlisting. Each defensive technique has a reference from its knowledge base article, the ATT&CK mitigations D3FEND relates them to are included, as are the NIST SP 800-53 controls mapped to Dynamic Analysis. Every class, individual and link is taken from the D3FEND 1.6.0 knowledge graph.

properties.name: Executable File

properties.name: Outbound Internet Web Traffic
